endorsements.quote: However, it is strongly recommended that a hybrid approach combining AI-driven insights with human oversight be maintained to ensure that the technology supports, rather than replaces, clinical judgment.

unlisted_practices: Validate AI tools early within their intended context of use to ensure reliability and regulatory compliance in clinical research.
Maintain continuous human oversight at every stage of the clinical research cycle.
Ensure researchers, regulators, and technology developers collaborate on responsible deployment of AI in clinical research.

screen.reason: Editorial providing recommendations and a roadmap for the responsible integration and governance of AI across the lifecycle of clinical trials.
